skill.summary: Build a meditation practice with guided sessions, streaks, and mindfulness reminders

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of mindfulness-meditation skill.
- Guided sessions for various meditation types, including Body Scan, Breath Focus, Loving-Kindness, Walking, and Open Awareness.
- Tracks meditation streaks and logs session history with details and notes.
- Offers daily or custom mindfulness reminders.
- Multiple session lengths, including quick 2–5 minute practices and custom durations.
- All user data is securely stored locally on your device.
